definitions.explanation: A heated appliance with a flat metal base used to press wrinkles out of clothing and fabric.

examples.japanese: スチームアイロンを{買|か}った。
ワイシャツにアイロンをかける。
アイロンが{熱|あつ}すぎて{服|ふく}を{焦|こ}がしてしまった。
examples.english: The iron was too hot and I scorched my clothes.

notes:
From English/Dutch "iron." Refers specifically to the clothes-pressing appliance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アイロンをかける: to iron (the standard verb pairing)
- アイロンを{当|あ}てる: to press with an iron (gentler; for delicate fabrics)
- アイロン{台|だい}: ironing board
- スチームアイロン: steam iron
- ドライアイロン: dry iron

USAGE:
The most important collocation is アイロンをかける — this is the natural way to say "to iron" in Japanese. Note that かける is used (not する).

RELATED:
- {洗濯|せんたく}: laundry
- しわ: wrinkle
- しわを{伸|の}ばす: to smooth out wrinkles
